title: High-level secretory production of leghemoglobin in Pichia pastoris through enhanced globin expression and heme biosynthesis
one_line_finding: 3.5 g/L secreted soy leghemoglobin with 93% heme binding in a 10-L fed-batch - the benchmark secreted globin titer; multi-copy LegH + heme pathway engineering + ku70 complementation.

title: Biosynthesis of High-Active Hemoproteins by the Efficient Heme-Supply Pichia Pastoris Chassis
one_line_finding: Stepwise K. phaffii chassis build (P1 globin strain x HEME-9 heme strain = P1H9) giving 246.95 mg/L porcine Mb, 286.53 mg/L soy Hb, 66.30 mg/L VHb at shake-flask scale; richest single source of comparable globin rows.

title: Developing a novel heme biosensor to produce high-active hemoproteins in Pichia pastoris through comparative transcriptomics
one_line_finding: Heme-responsive promoter + CRISPR/dCas9 + N-degron biosensor dynamically balances heme supply in the P1H9 chassis; reported elsewhere as 296.6 mg/L porcine Mb (highest P. pastoris myoglobin figure).

title: Systematic engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae for efficient synthesis of hemoglobins and myoglobins
one_line_finding: First microbial synthesis of bovine and porcine Hb; S. cerevisiae reached 108.2 mg/L soybean Hb, 13.7 mg/L clover Hb, 68.9 mg/L bovine Mb, 85.9 mg/L porcine Mb - the reference S. cerevisiae globin ceiling.

title: Efficient Secretory Expression and Purification of Food-Grade Porcine Myoglobin in Komagataella phaffii
one_line_finding: First heterologous myoglobin production report: 285.42 mg/L secreted porcine Mb in K. phaffii X33 fed-batch (alpha-MF, modified constitutive G1 promoter, 150 mg/L hemin feed); only 0.22 mol heme/mol Mb.

title: Enhancing heme import to synthesize active myoglobin and hemoglobin in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Heterologous heme importers Caflc1 and Shu1 screened via a HEM1-knockout P. pastoris; raised porcine Mb 112% and soybean Hb 5.78-fold - fold-changes only, no absolute titers in the abstract.

title: Constructing an Antibiotic-Free Protein Expression System for Ovalbumin Biosynthesis in Probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917
one_line_finding: 3.70 g/L intracellular ovalbumin in a 3-L bioreactor on the native cryptic plasmid pMUT2 (dual PP5+Ptac promoter, RBS8) - highest OVA titer in any prokaryote and the overall egg-protein record outside the quail-OVA outlier.

title: Production of bovine beta-lactoglobulin and hen egg ovalbumin by Trichoderma reesei using precision fermentation technology and testing of their techno-functional properties
one_line_finding: 2 g/L secreted ovalbumin (and 1 g/L beta-lactoglobulin) from T. reesei M1908 in bioreactor; Man5-glycosylated, excellent foaming and heat gelation - the only fungal-host OVA titer and the key T. reesei datapoint.

title: Animal-free production of hen egg ovalbumin in engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae via precision fermentation
one_line_finding: EPX1 signal peptide (from P. pastoris) plus PDI1+KAR2 co-expression gave 2 mg/L secreted OVA in flask and 132 mg/L total / 8 mg/L extracellular in glucose-limited fed-batch - secretion, not synthesis, is the bottleneck.

title: Modification of the Endoplasmic Reticulum to Enhance Ovalbumin Secretion in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: INU1 signal peptide + Kar2/PDI + OPI1/INO2/INO4 ER-membrane expansion stacked to 6.2 mg/L in flask and 116.3 mg/L in a 3-L fed-batch; independent replication of the S. cerevisiae OVA ceiling.

title: Alleviation of ER stress via targeted genetic engineering enhances recombinant ovalbumin secretion in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: PAH1 deletion (phospholipid-biosynthesis repressor) on the +P1/K2 background raised secreted OVA to 5.68 mg/L, +74% over background - ER membrane biogenesis as the lever.

title: A toolkit for facilitating markerless integration of expression cassettes in Komagataella phaffii via CRISPR/Cas9
one_line_finding: CRISPR/Cas9 markerless multi-locus integration toolkit using ovalbumin as reporter; average 35 mg/L secreted OVA, and the cleanest literature survey of prior K. phaffii OVA numbers.

title: Cloning of a novel ovalbumin gene from quail oviduct and its heterologous expression in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Claims 5.45 g/L secreted quail ovalbumin after 48 h methanol induction (ELISA) - by far the highest egg-protein figure on record and a probable over-estimate; flagged as an outlier.

title: Recombinant expression of hen egg white lysozyme with the assistance of xylanase fusion partner in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: ~3.5 g/L HEWL in fed-batch using a XynCDBFV xylanase carrier fusion with a protease-cleavable linker - highest egg-white-derived lysozyme titer reported; carrier-fusion is the enabling trick.

title: High yield secretion of the sweet-tasting protein lysozyme from the yeast Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: ~400 mg/L purified recombinant HEWL from P. pastoris pPIC6alpha fermenter culture; enabled human sensory panels (lysozyme is sweet-tasting).

title: Medium optimization for hen egg white lysozyme production by recombinant Aspergillus niger using statistical methods
one_line_finding: 209 +/- 18 mg/L HEWL from A. niger WT-13-16 after fractional-factorial + central-composite medium optimisation; peptone, starch and ammonium sulfate were the controlling factors.

title: A truncated glucoamylase gene fusion for heterologous protein secretion from Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: Peak 1 g/L HEWL in A. niger SHAKE FLASK via a truncated glucoamylase (G498) carrier fusion vs ~50 mg/L without - a 10-20x carrier effect and the key prior art for carrier-based fungal food-protein secretion.

title: Hen egg white lysozyme expressed in, and secreted from, Aspergillus niger is correctly processed and folded
one_line_finding: First A. niger HEWL secretion: 12 mg/L under the A. awamori glucoamylase promoter vs 1 mg/L under pgpdA; correct signal processing, native fold (2D NMR) and native specific activity.

title: Physiological optimization of secreted protein production by Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: HEWL yield in A. niger is strongly physiology-dependent: 8-10 mg/L at 20-25 C vs 3-5 mg/L at 30-37 C; 30-60 mg/L in rich soya-milk medium; starch > maltose > glucose >> xylose.

title: Expression and purification of a recombinant avidin with a lowered isoelectric point in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: ~330 mg/L secreted codon-optimised glycosylated avidin from P. pastoris with native-like biotin binding; the only substantial avidin titer in a fungal host.

title: Transcriptional and post-transcriptional events affect the production of secreted hen egg white lysozyme by Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: HEWL secretion scales with gene copy number below ~25 copies and with multiple copies at a single locus; cDNA-only transformants show a 10x higher mRNA:protein ratio than glucoamylase fusions - post-transcriptional steps dominate.

title: Bioprocessing strategies for improving hen egg-white lysozyme (HEWL) production by recombinant Aspergillus niger HEWL WT-13-16
one_line_finding: pH control at 4.0 cut protease activity >5-fold; immobilised, pelleted and dispersed morphologies compared. Yields given only as specific values (4.1-5.8 mg/g dry wt), so no volumetric row could be extracted.

title: Scientific and technological challenges of recombinant egg protein production
one_line_finding: The single most valuable secondary source for this batch: Table 2 compiles every published and company-disclosed egg-protein titer with host, plasmid, promoter, duration, localisation and assay; also sets ~50 g/L as the economic-viability threshold.

title: The next food revolution is here: Recombinant microbial production of milk and egg proteins by precision fermentation
one_line_finding: Source of the ~50 g/L titer target for commercially viable recombinant food proteins that the egg-protein review benchmarks against; cited, not independently retrieved.

title: Soy Leghemoglobin: A review of its structure, production, safety aspects, and food applications
one_line_finding: Dedicated LegH review covering structure, production routes, safety and food use; DOI not independently confirmed - treat the identifier as provisional.

title: Applications of the Whole-Cell System in the Efficient Biosynthesis of Heme
one_line_finding: Review of whole-cell heme biosynthesis; useful for free-heme titers across hosts (the supply-side constraint on every globin titer in this batch).

title: Sustainable and high-level microbial production of plant hemoglobin in Corynebacterium glutamicum
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host (C. glutamicum) but the open full text is the best cross-host summary of globin titers; also reports engineered free heme at 242.95 mg/L and ALA at 18.5 g/L in that host.

title: Compartmentalization of heme biosynthetic pathways into yeast mitochondria enhances heme production
one_line_finding: Relocating the protoporphyrin- and coproporphyrin-dependent pathways plus GroELS chaperonins into S. cerevisiae mitochondria gave 4.6 mg/L heme; frames the 380.5 mg/L S. cerevisiae heme record as the ceiling to aim at.

title: Metabolic engineering of Bacillus subtilis for the production of active hemoglobins and myoglobins by improving heme supply
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host (B. subtilis) but reaches 0.82-1.11 g/L C-Hb/B-Mb/P-Mb in 15 h via a push-restrain-pull-block heme strategy; also the source of the cross-referenced 296.6 mg/L P. pastoris P-Mb figure.

title: High-level expression of leghemoglobin in Kluyveromyces marxianus by remodeling the heme metabolism pathway
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host (K. marxianus) but reports 7.27 g/L INTRACELLULAR leghemoglobin A with 66.32 mg/L heme in a 5-L fermentor; the open full text independently corroborates the 3.5 g/L Pichia and 108 mg/L S. cerevisiae figures.

title: Integrated Fermentation Engineering Enables High-Level Leghemoglobin Production in Kluyveromyces marxianus via Metabolic Rewiring of Central Carbon Metabolism and Amino Acid Utilization
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host but the highest leghemoglobin titer anywhere: 10.1 g/L in 5-L bioreactors (from 6.13 g/L) at 0.026 g/g glucose - the yield figure any K. phaffii process should be benchmarked against.

title: Pichia pastoris growth-coupled heme biosynthesis analysis using metabolic modelling
one_line_finding: Genome-scale model of K. phaffii heme biosynthesis identifying growth-coupled intervention targets; relevant to designing heme supply for globin expression rather than to titers.

title: Metabolic engineering of Komagataella phaffii for enhanced production of heterologous proteins and small molecules
one_line_finding: Recent K. phaffii metabolic-engineering review; host-level context for promoter, chaperone and protease-deletion choices seen across the globin and egg-protein rows.

title: Cell-Free Production of Soybean Leghemoglobins and Nonsymbiotic Hemoglobin
one_line_finding: Cell-free (not a host) synthesis of LegH A/C1/C2/C3 and nonsymbiotic Hb at ~0.5 mg/mL with peroxidase activity; the only source covering plant NON-SYMBIOTIC hemoglobin production, and it corroborates ~400 U/mg at 250 mg/L for Pichia-made LegH.

title: Production of Recombinant Hemoglobin in Tremella fuciformis Yeast-like Cells Through Selection of Heme and Signal Peptides
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host but a clean signal-peptide comparison for globin secretion: chicken Hb 32.00 mg/L intracellular rising to 106.43 mg/L extracellular with the Amf leader, vs CysR 72.54 and Gla 49.50 mg/L; also 19.03 mg/L VHb and 23.51 mg/L Lb2.

title: Sustainable production of myoglobin meat protein in plant chloroplasts
one_line_finding: Out-of-scope host (plants/algae): porcine Mb at 2.7% TSP in tobacco and 1.5% in lettuce chloroplasts, but only ~35% heme occupancy vs 80% for E. coli-made Mb - confirms heme availability as the cross-platform bottleneck.

title: Assessment of soy leghemoglobin produced from genetically modified Komagataella phaffii, under Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003
one_line_finding: The best public strain disclosure for commercial LegH: K. phaffii MXY0541 (parent Bg11 from NRRL Y-11430), soy LGB2 in three cassettes at three loci, native haem pathway upregulated, fed-batch, lysate product, LegH = 68-77% of total protein. No volumetric titer disclosed.

title: Safety of soy leghemoglobin from genetically modified Komagataella phaffii as a food additive
one_line_finding: EFSA ANS-side opinion: no safety concern at proposed use levels, but the authorisation is tied specifically to production strain MXY0541 - a regulatory constraint on strain re-engineering worth noting for any process design.

title: The Safety of Soy Leghemoglobin Protein Preparation Derived from Pichia pastoris Expressing a Soy Leghemoglobin Gene
one_line_finding: Impossible Foods toxicology package for LegH Prep; confirms submerged fed-batch fermentation of an LegH-overexpressing K. phaffii and strain lineage MXY0291 / NRRL Y-11430. No titers. DOI provisional.

title: Evaluating Potential Risks of Food Allergy and Toxicity of Soy Leghemoglobin Expressed in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Earlier allergenicity/toxicity assessment of Pichia-expressed soy LegH; relevant to regulatory feasibility rather than to titers. DOI provisional.

title: Safety Evaluation of Soy Leghemoglobin Protein Preparation Derived From Pichia pastoris, Intended for Use as a Flavor Catalyst in Plant-Based Meat
one_line_finding: The GRAS-supporting safety study behind FDA GRN 737 for LegH Prep; process described only qualitatively. DOI provisional.

title: Assessment of the potential allergenicity and toxicity of Pichia proteins in a novel leghemoglobin preparation
one_line_finding: Assesses the residual HOST-protein fraction of LegH Prep - directly relevant because LegH is only 68-77% of product protein, so host-protein carryover is a product-spec constraint. DOI provisional.

title: Allergenic risk assessment of porcine myoglobin expressed by engineered Komagataella Phaffii
one_line_finding: Sensitisation in mice tracked inversely with myoglobin purity (60% and 88% purity were less sensitising than the ovalbumin control), implicating the non-myoglobin host fraction - a purification requirement, not a protein-intrinsic risk.

title: Methods and Compositions for Egg White Protein Production (WO2016077457)
one_line_finding: Company/patent source of the two highest yeast egg-protein claims: 3.2 g/L ovomucoid in 168 h under pAOX1 and 1 g/L under pGAP in K. phaffii. Read only via the BMC Biotechnol review table, not the patent itself.

title: Ovalbumin production using Trichoderma reesei culture and low-carbon energy could mitigate the environmental impacts of chicken-egg-derived ovalbumin
one_line_finding: Anticipatory LCA of T. reesei ovalbumin at pilot scale against dried egg-white powder: lower agricultural impacts, higher industrial-electricity and glucose burdens. Companion to Aro et al. 2023.

title: High-level production of recombinant chicken cystatin by Pichia pastoris and its application in mackerel surimi
one_line_finding: Multi-copy chromosomal pGAP cassette secretes active chicken cystatin from P. pastoris X-33 with native-like papain inhibition - but the abstract reports NO mg/L figure, which is the main unresolved gap in this batch.

title: Effect of glycosylation modification (N-Q-108I -> N-Q-108T) on the freezing stability of recombinant chicken Cystatin overexpressed in Pichia pastoris X-33
one_line_finding: pGAPZalphaC / alpha-MF secretion of chicken cystatin and an Asn106-glycosylation mutant; N-glycosylation improved freezing stability at the cost of inhibitory potency (Ki 0.08 -> 9.5 nM). No titers.

title: Glycosylation modification improved the characteristics of recombinant chicken cystatin and its application on mackerel surimi
one_line_finding: Hyperglycosylated chicken cystatin (~50 mannose DP, 55 kDa apparent) from P. pastoris X-33 with improved thermal, pH and freeze-thaw stability - a caution that K. phaffii O/N-hyperglycosylation materially changes egg-protein properties. No titers.

title: Overexpression of the soluble form of chicken cystatin in Escherichia coli and its purification
one_line_finding: Soluble active chicken cystatin from E. coli AD494(DE3)pLysS purified by heat treatment plus gel filtration; no volumetric yield reported.

title: Expression of a synthetic gene coding for ostrich egg-white lysozyme in Pichia pastoris and its enzymatic activity
one_line_finding: Synthetic goose-type (ostrich) egg-white lysozyme gene secreted from P. pastoris pPIC9K, but processed at three sites including the correct one - a signal-processing-fidelity warning for alpha-MF constructs. No titer.

title: Structure-sweetness relationship in egg white lysozyme: role of lysine and arginine residues on the elicitation of lysozyme sweetness
one_line_finding: Pichia-expressed HEWL mutant panel mapping the sweet-taste determinants (Lys13, Lys96, Arg14, Arg21, Arg73) - functional rationale for HEWL as a food protein. No titers.

title: Expression, purification, and characterization of the recombinant calcium-binding equine lysozyme secreted by the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: Non-egg lysozymes from A. niger (equine >50 mg/L in PVP medium, up to 150 mg/L in soya medium; human >40 mg/L) and the finding that added Ca2+ REDUCED HEWL yield; useful host-level comparator, out of target scope.

title: Expressed Soybean Leghemoglobin: Effect on Escherichia coli at Oxidative and Nitrosative Stress
one_line_finding: Soybean leghemoglobin a expressed in E. coli in an active oxygenated state, but the host became MORE sensitive to oxidative/nitrosative stress - a host-burden caveat for bacterial globin production. No titer.

title: Expression of bovine myoglobin cDNA as a functionally active holoprotein in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: Earliest yeast globin report: bovine Mb under GAL7 reached ~1% of total extractable protein as a reversibly O2-binding holoprotein with correct N-terminal Met processing. Percentage-of-protein basis only, so no mg/L row.

title: Apomyoglobin as a molecular recognition surface: expression, reconstitution and crystallization of recombinant porcine myoglobin in Escherichia coli
one_line_finding: Classic lambda-cII fusion route to porcine apomyoglobin in E. coli with in vitro heme reconstitution - the apo-expression-plus-reconstitution alternative to in vivo heme supply. No titer.

title: Optimal fermentation conditions for growth and recombinant protein production in Pichia pastoris: Strain selection, ploidy level and carbon source
one_line_finding: Systematic K. phaffii strain / ploidy / carbon-source screen for food-protein production; process-covariate reference for interpreting the shake-flask vs fed-batch spread in this batch. DOI provisional.

title: Systematic optimization of Komagataella phaffii (Pichia pastoris) for high-efficiency recombinant protein production
one_line_finding: Recent systematic K. phaffii optimisation review surfaced by the leghemoglobin queries; host-level background. DOI provisional - verify before citing.
